selected_css_matches_v3: #menu, #pause, #results { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; padding-left: 7vw; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(3, 4, 20, 0.85) 0%, rgba(3, 4, 20, 0.35) 45%, transparent 70%); z-index: 10; }
.menu-card { width: 470px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.menu-card.small { width: 380px; padding: 30px; background: var(--bg); border: 2px solid var(--c); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(25, 230, 255, 0.4); }
.brand { font: 900 64px/0.95 var(--font); color: #fff; letter-spacing: 4px; text-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--c); }

button { pointer-events: auto; font: 700 20px var(--font); letter-spacing: 3px; color: #dff; background: rgba(6, 14, 46, 0.8); border: 2px solid var(--c); padding: 16px 22px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer;
.pause-hint { font: 600 11px var(--font); letter-spacing: 2px; color: #7fa9c4; text-align: center; }
.pause-contact, .small-contact { font: 500 14px Rajdhani, sans-serif; color: #9bd; text-align: center; margin-top: 6px; }
#pause { justify-content: flex-start; padding-left: 6vw; cursor: grab; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(3, 4, 20, 0.82) 0%, rgba(3, 4, 20, 0.3) 32%, transparent 50%); }
